claims.claim: You can archive your finished project in just a few clicks
You can bring it back anytime if needed
Go to Projects and open the project you want to archive
Click Settings > Archive project
Confirm the action in the dialog
The project will disappear from your active project list and move to Projects > Archived
Once archived, the project becomes read-only
No one can create, edit, or delete tasks
You can still view it and all its tasks anytime
Archiving will also help with performance since archived projects don't appear in the main project list or workspace search by default
Go to Projects > Archived
Find the project
Click the three-dot menu next to the project name and select Restore
The project returns to your active list fully editable
All tasks, comments, and history stay intact
